label: Original-phase input 3/c/d at mid positions 4-6, after certain letters
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, almost entirely at positions t=4-6 (peak t=5), never at the delimiter or in the copy phase, and never at t<3. The input token is the main factor: digit 3 (53% of mass) and letter c (30%), then d (5%) and a little 2. The previous token makes it more likely (b, j, a, p, f, e). The top activations are almost all 3 at t=5 coming after a letter, and first occurrences are favored. Even so, most steps that meet these conditions do not fire (precision about 0.12), so the unit is a sparse thresholded slice of a dense mix of features. The context-free version (3/c/d at t=4-6) covers 86% of mass at about 4% precision.
